notes.title: Theyest Thou: Escape From Neosopha update released!
notes.content:

notes.title: Update: Added Hard Mode, Key Binding, QoL improvements
notes.content:
Added Hard Mode and difficulty settings ( doubles enemies health)
Add Key Binding options in settings
changed colors of ui icons for guns to make them easier to see
Increased text size
Made terminal displays scale with zoom
